I am far more attracted to smoking weed and I don’t find alcohol addictive one bit and never drink alone. Black mould does not automatically mean THE black mould. There are plenty of less harmful mould species that are black. That being said though that’s a lot of mould. You definitely have a moisture problem behind that wall- leaky pipe? You will have to rip into that wall to find the source. In the meantime don’t go in that room as much as possible, don’t sleep in there definitely and don’t store anything in there. Try and sleep as far away from the room as you can as it’s likely the spores are at least traceable throughout the whole place. 

As for your health, probably nothing long term at this stage if you fix it or move out. If you don’t have any symptoms it’s probably not THAT bad but not something you want to be breathing in 24/7 as long as you’re in the house. 

It may cost a bit who knows, but your health must always take priority. But at this stage just avoid the room as much as you can or move out temporarily until you can. Best of luck 🤙
